% A package or a class of the writer's in a TeX tree of the writer's
% (TEXMFHOME or TEXMFLOCAL) that reads, with the primitive \input, a file
% that gives the name of a tex4ht configuration file in \ProvidesFile.
% Built as it is, the document finds no such package or class, and the
% page says so. run.mjs builds it again from each folder of
% test-texmfpkg/: the document is copied to the folder's doc/, which holds
% the files beside the document, and the folder's texmf/ is TEXMFHOME, or
% TEXMFLOCAL in one build. As in the PDF, each case's text is in the page,
% and tex4ht reads no .4ht of the names the files give.
% - texmfpkg-class.cls, a class in the tree, when the folder has one.
% - texmfpkg-lib.sty, a package in the tree, when the folder has one.
%   The file it reads defines \texmfpkgtext, the case's text.
% index.4ht defines \printindex, glossary.4ht \gloskip, and framed.4ht
% \a:makeframed, so the page shows when one of them was read: a sentence
% the PDF does not have.
\IfFileExists{texmfpkg-class.cls}
  {\documentclass{texmfpkg-class}}
  {\documentclass{article}}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\IfFileExists{texmfpkg-lib.sty}{\usepackage{texmfpkg-lib}}{}
\providecommand\texmfpkgtext{No package or class in TEXMFHOME or TEXMFLOCAL.}
\begin{document}
\texmfpkgtext
\ifdefined\printindex\par Index read for the web.\fi
\ifdefined\gloskip\par Glossary read for the web.\fi
\expandafter\ifx\csname a:makeframed\endcsname\relax\else\par Framed read for the web.\fi
\ifdefined\texmfpkgextra\par\texmfpkgextra\fi
\end{document}
